name: Shopbop

prices.note: Like-for-like item: women's jeans. All 21 pages (offset=0..2000, 2,024 products) of the Jeans category read from the page's embedded product data; 1,015 on-sale items excluded and 63 non-jean items (shorts, skirts, jackets etc., by title) dropped, leaving 946 regular-price jeans from 78 labels. Lowest: Free People Breezy Denim Pull On Jeans $78; highest: Marni Denim Trousers / Rivet Jeans $1,550. Most-stocked labels: MOTHER 70, AGOLDE 63, Citizens of Humanity 52, DL1961 40, rag & bone 40.

notes: Homepage title: 'Shopbop - Designer Clothing, Shoes, Bags & Accessories'. Sells many designer labels (Designers section).

About page: retailer 'since 1999', 'part of the Amazon.com Inc. group of companies', 'a global online retail destination for style inspiration and discovery'. HQ not stated on site; Wikipedia: Madison, Wisconsin; Amazon acquired it in February 2006.

Customer service page: US 3-Day and 2-Day shipping free with no order minimum; destination list includes Canada, United Kingdom and Australia. Returns: 30 days; free if dropped off within 15 days of delivery, $10 label fee per order for days 16–30.
Sizes are from the Jeans page filters (denim 22–38; clothing 00, XXS … 24, 3XL). No plus, petite or tall filter, so those flags are left empty.
